hero.title: AEROSPACE ENGINEERING PG IN FRANCE FOR INDIAN STUDENTS
hero.subtitle: **Studying Postgraduate Aerospace Engineering in France**** can give students advanced knowledge and technical skills in fields like aircraft design, aerodynamics, propulsion, aerospace structures, flight dynamics and space systems. **French universities and engineering specialist schools** offer ****Master’s programs in Aerospace Engineering**** that blend scientific fundamentals, laboratory research, hands-on design projects and industrial experience.

overview: **Studying Postgraduate Aerospace Engineering in France**** can give students advanced knowledge and technical skills in fields like aircraft design, aerodynamics, propulsion, aerospace structures, flight dynamics and space systems. **French universities and engineering specialist schools** offer ****Master’s programs in Aerospace Engineering**** that blend scientific fundamentals, laboratory research, hands-on design projects and industrial experience.

**Aerospace Engineering studies** are in demand in France because of its well-established aircraft manufacturing, aviation research, and space technology industries. Indian and other international students can choose from postgraduate programs taught in English or French, depending on their academic interests and preferred specialization.
Students can avail of these opportunities and know the requirements involved in pursuing education overseas through **Edu Hawk’s worldwide study abroad guidance.**

sections.title: 1. How long is a postgraduate aerospace engineering course in France?

items: A national master's degree usually lasts two years, consisting of M1 and M2, with 120 ECTS credits. Postgraduate qualifications for specialists vary in length and entry requirements.

sections.title: 2. Can Indian students do Aerospace Engineering PG in France?

items: Yeah. Indian students can apply for **Aerospace Engineering PG in France** if they meet the academic, language, and documentation requirements. Being accepted to a university and being issued a student visa are two separate things.

sections.title: 3. Do I have to take IELTS for aerospace engineering masters in France?

items: Not every time. English taught programs may require IELTS, TOEFL or an equivalent accepted test or approved proof of previous education in English. Some of the programs are taught in French and may require proficiency in French.

sections.title: 4. Aerospace Engineering PG Tuition Fee in France?

items: For 2026-2027 the indicative annual fee for a national master's degree at covered public institutions is €255 for EU/EEA/Swiss students and €3,950 for non-EU students liable to differential fees. Specialist aerospace programs and engineering schools may have different tuition arrangements .
5: What are the jobs after PG in Aerospace Engineering in France?

Graduates may be employed in aircraft design, aerodynamics, propulsion, aerospace structures, space systems, flight dynamics, avionics and research and development. Opportunities will depend on technical skills, experience, language ability and employer needs.

sections.title: 8. Recognition and Accreditation of Aerospace Engineering Degrees**

items: Students should check what qualification is actually awarded by the institution before accepting an offer.

A **diplôme national de master**, the French national master's degree, is recognized within the French higher education system and the European higher education framework. This usually corresponds to five years of higher education, in addition to what came before at the bachelor's level.

Another qualification is the engineering diploma ( * diplôme d'ingénieur * ) . Applicants for engineering-school programs should verify that the institution is authorized and, where relevant, recognized by the Commission des titres d’ingénieur (CTI).
**Check before you apply:**
* - Title of the degree and the awarding institution.
* - whether the program leads to a national master’s degree, an engineering diploma or a specialization.
* - The institution’s accreditation or recognition status.
* - The length and academic credit.
* - Recognition requirements for employment or further study in your country of choice.
Students from India who want to go back after graduation should check qualification requirements with potential employers, universities or the appropriate authorities.

sections.title: 9. Aerospace Engineering PG Salary & Job Opportunities in France**

items: A ****Master’s in Aerospace Engineering in France**** can help you find career opportunities in aircraft design, space systems, propulsion, simulation, aerospace structures, and engineering research.
Employment results depend on technical skills, internships, professional experience, language skills, security or export-control restrictions where applicable and the hiring market.
**Potential jobs after doing a PG in Aerospace Engineering in France are**:
* Aerospace Design Engineer
* Aerodynamics Engineer
* Computational Fluid Dynamics Engineer
* Aerospace Structures Engineer
* Propulsion Engineer
* Flight Dynamics Engineer
* Space Systems Engineer
* Avionics or Control Systems Engineer
* Aircraft Performance Engineer
* Aerospace Testing and Validation Engineer
* Research and Development Engineer
* Simulation Engineer

Possible employers are aircraft manufacturing, space systems, aviation, defense, engineering consultancies, advanced materials and research organizations. Certain positions may require citizenship, security clearance, or export control qualifications, especially those related to defense contracts.
Expected Salary in France after PG in Aerospace Engineering
There is not a one salary for all aerospace engineering graduates. Compensation varies by employer, role, location, experience, technical specialization and contract type.

Students are to compare current job advertisements and salary surveys for the field they have chosen. When you are evaluating a job offer, take into account gross salary, taxes and social contributions, housing costs and other living expenses.

sections.title: 10. Documents for PG in Aerospace Engineering in France

items: Common documents students need to submit when applying for ****Aerospace Engineering master’s programs in France****
* Valid Passport
* Bachelor’s degree certificate or provisional degree certificate.
* Transcripts (official)
* CV or résumé.
* Motivation Letter (Statement of Purpose).
* Letters of recommendation, if required.
* English language test results, where applicable.
* Certificate in French, as appropriate.
* Course Syllabus or descriptions available upon request.
* Details of applicable technical projects and internships.
* Certificates of experience or employment, if any.
* Passport size photographs, if needed.
* Proof of payment of application fee, if applicable.

Some institutions require translations to be certified and in French or English. Additional documentation may be required for visa applications, such as proof of finances and accommodation where relevant.
Details available upon request.
